items.question: Trong câu "Security is a quality attribute, like availability: the shape of the system decides how much damage one bug, one leaked key or one compromised host can do.", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security is a quality attribute, like availability: the shape of the system decides how much damage one bug, one leaked key or one compromised host can do.", what does "attribute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (danh từ): thuộc tính, đặc tính. "Quality attribute" = thuộc tính chất lượng của hệ thống, như tính sẵn sàng hay bảo mật.
items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (noun): a quality or feature. "Quality attribute" is a property of a whole system, such as availability or security.

items.question: Trong câu "Security is a quality attribute, like availability: the shape of the system decides how much damage one bug, one leaked key or one compromised host can do.", từ "compromise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security is a quality attribute, like availability: the shape of the system decides how much damage one bug, one leaked key or one compromised host can do.", what does "compromise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compromise /ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/ (động từ): xâm phạm, chiếm quyền. "A compromised host" = máy chủ đã bị kẻ tấn công chiếm quyền; nghĩa "thoả hiệp" dùng trong đàm phán.
items.explanationEn: compromise /ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/ (verb): to break the security of. "A compromised host" is a machine an attacker controls; the sense "to settle by concession" is used in negotiation.

items.question: Trong câu "The architect's job is to design a system where mistakes are contained, detected and recoverable.", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The architect's job is to design a system where mistakes are contained, detected and recoverable.", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): khoanh vùng, kiềm chế. Trong bảo mật, "contain an incident" = khoanh vùng sự cố để nó không lan rộng.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep within limits. In security, "contain an incident" means stopping it from spreading further.

items.question: Trong câu "Zero trust (NIST SP 800-207) replaces network location with explicit verification: never trust, always verify every request, least privilege per request, assume breach, and decide using context (identity, device posture, risk).", từ "breach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Zero trust (NIST SP 800-207) replaces network location with explicit verification: never trust, always verify every request, least privilege per request, assume breach, and decide using context (identity, device posture, risk).", what does "breach" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breach /briːtʃ/ (danh từ): sự xâm nhập trái phép. "Assume breach" = luôn giả định hệ thống đã bị xâm nhập; "data breach" = rò rỉ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (noun): a security break-in. "Assume breach" means designing as if attackers are already inside; "data breach" is a data leak.

items.question: Trong câu "Zero trust (NIST SP 800-207) replaces network location with explicit verification: never trust, always verify every request, least privilege per request, assume breach, and decide using context (identity, device posture, risk).", từ "posture" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Zero trust (NIST SP 800-207) replaces network location with explicit verification: never trust, always verify every request, least privilege per request, assume breach, and decide using context (identity, device posture, risk).", what does "posture" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: posture /ˈpɒstʃə(r)/ (danh từ): trạng thái an toàn. "Device posture" = trạng thái bảo mật của thiết bị (đã vá, có mã hoá ổ đĩa...); nghĩa gốc là tư thế.
items.explanationEn: posture /ˈpɒstʃə(r)/ (noun): a state of security. "Device posture" is how secure a device is (patched, disk encrypted...); the basic sense is body position.

items.question: Trong câu "One compromised laptop then allows free lateral movement.", từ "lateral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One compromised laptop then allows free lateral movement.", what does "lateral" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lateral /ˈlætərəl/ (tính từ): ngang, sang bên. "Lateral movement" = kẻ tấn công di chuyển ngang từ máy này sang máy khác trong mạng.
items.explanationEn: lateral /ˈlætərəl/ (adjective): going sideways. "Lateral movement" is an attacker hopping sideways from one internal machine to another.

items.question: Trong câu "That is your blast radius.", từ "blast radius" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is your blast radius.", what does "blast radius" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: blast radius /blɑːst ˈreɪdiəs/ (cụm từ): phạm vi thiệt hại. Nghĩa đen là bán kính vụ nổ; trong kiến trúc là phạm vi bị ảnh hưởng khi một thành phần hỏng.
items.explanationEn: blast radius /blɑːst ˈreɪdiəs/ (phrase): the extent of damage. Literally the area hit by an explosion; in architecture, how much is affected when one part fails.

items.question: Trong câu "Security trades against cost and speed; the right answer is controls proportional to the data's value and the likely threats, recorded as a decision.", từ "proportional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security trades against cost and speed; the right answer is controls proportional to the data's value and the likely threats, recorded as a decision.", what does "proportional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proportional /prəˈpɔːʃənl/ (tính từ): tương xứng với. "Proportional to something" = tương xứng/tỉ lệ với cái gì; biện pháp bảo mật nên tương xứng với giá trị dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: proportional /prəˈpɔːʃənl/ (adjective): matching in size to. "Proportional to something" means matching its size or importance; controls should match the data's value.

items.question: Trong câu "The cloud provider secures facilities, hardware and hypervisor; you still own identities, data, network rules and code.", từ "facility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cloud provider secures facilities, hardware and hypervisor; you still own identities, data, network rules and code.", what does "facility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: facility /fəˈsɪləti/ (danh từ): cơ sở vật chất. Ở số nhiều, "facilities" thường chỉ toà nhà, trung tâm dữ liệu; "facility with languages" lại là năng khiếu.
items.explanationEn: facility /fəˈsɪləti/ (noun): a physical site or building. In the plural, "facilities" usually means buildings such as data centres; "a facility with languages" means a skill.

items.question: Trong câu "Defence in depth layers independent controls so no single failure exposes the asset.", từ "layer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Defence in depth layers independent controls so no single failure exposes the asset.", what does "layer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (động từ): xếp thành nhiều lớp. "Layer" thường là danh từ (lớp), ở đây là động từ: chồng nhiều lớp kiểm soát độc lập lên nhau.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (verb): to arrange in layers. "Layer" is usually a noun; here it is a verb meaning to stack independent controls on top of each other.

items.question: Trong câu "Defence in depth layers independent controls so no single failure exposes the asset.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Defence in depth layers independent controls so no single failure exposes the asset.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, phơi bày. "Expose data / a port to the internet" = để lộ dữ liệu hoặc cổng ra ngoài mà không được bảo vệ.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to leave unprotected. "Expose data or a port to the internet" means leaving it reachable without protection.

items.question: Trong câu "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", từ "eventually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", what does "eventually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: eventually /ɪˈventʃuəli/ (trạng từ): sớm muộn, cuối cùng. Lưu ý "eventually" không có nghĩa là "có thể xảy ra" (possibly); nó nói điều gì chắc chắn xảy ra về sau.
items.explanationEn: eventually /ɪˈventʃuəli/ (adverb): sooner or later. Note that "eventually" does not mean "possibly"; it says something will happen in the end.

items.question: Trong câu "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", từ "tamper-resistant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", what does "tamper-resistant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tamper-resistant /ˈtæmpə rɪˈzɪstənt/ (tính từ): khó bị sửa lén. Hậu tố "-resistant" = chống lại; log chống sửa đổi giúp kẻ tấn công không xoá được dấu vết.
items.explanationEn: tamper-resistant /ˈtæmpə rɪˈzɪstənt/ (adjective): hard to alter secretly. The suffix "-resistant" means able to withstand; tamper-resistant logs stop attackers erasing their tracks.

items.question: Trong câu "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", từ "rehearse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prevention eventually fails, so the detection layer — tamper-resistant central logs, alerts, a rehearsed runbook — decides how quickly you notice.", what does "rehearse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rehearse /rɪˈhɜːs/ (động từ): diễn tập trước. "A rehearsed runbook" = quy trình xử lý sự cố đã được diễn tập, giống diễn viên tập trước buổi diễn.
items.explanationEn: rehearse /rɪˈhɜːs/ (verb): to practise in advance. "A rehearsed runbook" is an incident procedure already practised, like actors rehearsing a play.

items.question: Trong câu "OAuth 2.0, OIDC and JWT pitfalls are covered in the API design topic.", từ "pitfall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OAuth 2.0, OIDC and JWT pitfalls are covered in the API design topic.", what does "pitfall" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (danh từ): cạm bẫy, lỗi dễ mắc. "Common pitfalls" = những lỗi thường gặp; hay dùng trong tài liệu kỹ thuật và phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (noun): a common hidden mistake. "Common pitfalls" are mistakes people often make; a frequent phrase in docs and interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "Workloads get identities (an IAM role for a pod, a SPIFFE ID) that yield short-lived credentials — never a static key in config.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workloads get identities (an IAM role for a pod, a SPIFFE ID) that yield short-lived credentials — never a static key in config.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): tạo ra, mang lại. "Yield a result / credentials" = sinh ra kết quả; nghĩa "nhường đường" thấy trên biển báo giao thông.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce as a result. "Yield a result" means to produce it; the sense "give way" appears on road signs.

items.question: Trong câu "Workloads get identities (an IAM role for a pod, a SPIFFE ID) that yield short-lived credentials — never a static key in config.", từ "static" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workloads get identities (an IAM role for a pod, a SPIFFE ID) that yield short-lived credentials — never a static key in config.", what does "static" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: static /ˈstætɪk/ (tính từ): cố định, không đổi. "A static key" = khoá cố định, không tự hết hạn; ngược với khoá ngắn hạn, tự xoay vòng.
items.explanationEn: static /ˈstætɪk/ (adjective): not changing over time. "A static key" never expires on its own, unlike short-lived, rotated credentials.

items.question: Trong câu "Just-in-time elevated access with approval and expiry instead of permanent admin.", từ "elevated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Just-in-time elevated access with approval and expiry instead of permanent admin.", what does "elevated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: elevated /ˈelɪveɪtɪd/ (tính từ): được nâng cao (quyền). "Elevated access / privileges" = quyền cao hơn bình thường, như quyền admin.
items.explanationEn: elevated /ˈelɪveɪtɪd/ (adjective): raised to a higher level. "Elevated access" or "elevated privileges" means more rights than usual, such as admin rights.

items.question: Trong câu "Just-in-time elevated access with approval and expiry instead of permanent admin.", từ "expiry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Just-in-time elevated access with approval and expiry instead of permanent admin.", what does "expiry" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the end of a valid period
items.explanation: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (danh từ): sự hết hạn. "Expiry date" = ngày hết hạn; quyền truy cập có hạn sẽ tự mất khi hết thời gian.
items.explanationEn: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (noun): the end of a valid period. "Expiry date" is the date something stops being valid; time-boxed access disappears on expiry.

items.question: Trong câu "Enforce authZ on the server, per object", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enforce authZ on the server, per object", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): thực thi bắt buộc. "Enforce a policy / rule" = buộc quy tắc phải được tuân thủ, không chỉ ghi trên giấy.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make a rule apply. "Enforce a policy" means making sure the rule is actually applied, not just written down.

items.question: Trong câu "A secret is anything that grants access: DB passwords, API keys, private and signing keys.", từ "grant" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A secret is anything that grants access: DB passwords, API keys, private and signing keys.", what does "grant" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: grant /ɡrɑːnt/ (động từ): cấp, trao (quyền). "Grant access / permissions to someone" = cấp quyền cho ai; trái nghĩa là "deny" hoặc "revoke".
items.explanationEn: grant /ɡrɑːnt/ (verb): to give permission. "Grant access to someone" means giving them permission; opposites are "deny" and "revoke".

items.question: Trong câu "Central store with access control and an audit trail of every read.", từ "audit trail" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Central store with access control and an audit trail of every read.", what does "audit trail" (phrase) mean?
options: dấu vết ghi nhận hoạt động
items.explanation: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (cụm từ): dấu vết ghi nhận hoạt động. "Trail" nghĩa gốc là đường mòn/dấu vết; "audit trail" là chuỗi bản ghi cho biết ai đã làm gì, khi nào.
items.explanationEn: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (phrase): a record of past actions. "Trail" basically means a path or track; an "audit trail" shows who did what and when.

items.question: Trong câu "Short-lived and rotated, injected at runtime using the workload's identity.", từ "rotate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Short-lived and rotated, injected at runtime using the workload's identity.", what does "rotate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rotate /rəʊˈteɪt/ (động từ): thay mới định kỳ. "Rotate keys / secrets" = thay khoá mới theo chu kỳ; nghĩa gốc là quay quanh trục.
items.explanationEn: rotate /rəʊˈteɪt/ (verb): to replace on a schedule. "Rotate keys" means replacing them regularly; the basic meaning is to turn around an axis.

items.question: Trong câu "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", từ "on demand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", what does "on demand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on demand /ɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (cụm từ): khi có yêu cầu. "On demand" = ngay khi cần; ví dụ "on-demand instances", "video on demand".
items.explanationEn: on demand /ɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (phrase): whenever requested. "On demand" means as soon as it is needed, as in "on-demand instances" or "video on demand".

items.question: Trong câu "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", từ "lease" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", what does "lease" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lease /liːs/ (danh từ): quyền dùng có thời hạn. Nghĩa gốc là hợp đồng thuê (nhà, xe); trong Vault, lease là thời hạn mà secret còn hiệu lực.
items.explanationEn: lease /liːs/ (noun): a time-limited right to use. Basically a rental contract; in Vault, a lease is how long a secret stays valid.

items.question: Trong câu "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", từ "revoke" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it creates a unique DB user on demand with a lease and revokes it when the lease expires.", what does "revoke" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: revoke /rɪˈvəʊk/ (động từ): thu hồi, huỷ bỏ. "Revoke access / a certificate / a token" = thu hồi quyền, chứng chỉ hoặc token để nó mất hiệu lực.
items.explanationEn: revoke /rɪˈvəʊk/ (verb): to cancel officially. "Revoke access", "revoke a certificate" or "revoke a token" means cancelling it so it no longer works.

items.question: Trong câu "Rotation must be designed: the app must accept old and new credentials during switch-over or re-read the secret without restart, and a leaked key should be revocable in minutes via a runbook.", từ "switch-over" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rotation must be designed: the app must accept old and new credentials during switch-over or re-read the secret without restart, and a leaked key should be revocable in minutes via a runbook.", what does "switch-over" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: switch-over /ˈswɪtʃ əʊvə(r)/ (danh từ): thời điểm chuyển đổi. "Switch-over" = giai đoạn chuyển từ cái cũ sang cái mới; khi đó cả hai phải cùng dùng được.
items.explanationEn: switch-over /ˈswɪtʃ əʊvə(r)/ (noun): a period of changeover. "Switch-over" is the moment of moving from old to new; both must work during it.

items.question: Trong câu "Rotation must be designed: the app must accept old and new credentials during switch-over or re-read the secret without restart, and a leaked key should be revocable in minutes via a runbook.", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rotation must be designed: the app must accept old and new credentials during switch-over or re-read the secret without restart, and a leaked key should be revocable in minutes via a runbook.", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): làm rò rỉ, để lộ. "A leaked key / password" = khoá hoặc mật khẩu bị lộ ra ngoài; nghĩa gốc là rò (nước, khí).
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to let out by accident. "A leaked key" is a secret that has escaped; the basic sense is liquid or gas escaping.

items.question: Trong câu "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", từ "hop" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", what does "hop" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a small jump on one foot
one leg of a network path
items.explanation: hop /hɒp/ (danh từ): chặng mạng. "Internal hops" = các chặng giữa các dịch vụ bên trong; nghĩa gốc "hop" là nhảy lò cò.
items.explanationEn: hop /hɒp/ (noun): one leg of a network path. "Internal hops" are legs between services inside the network; "hop" basically means a small jump.

items.question: Trong câu "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", từ "renewal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", what does "renewal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: renewal /rɪˈnjuːəl/ (danh từ): sự gia hạn, làm mới. "Certificate renewal" = gia hạn chứng chỉ trước khi hết hạn; động từ là "renew".
items.explanationEn: renewal /rɪˈnjuːəl/ (noun): making valid again. "Certificate renewal" means getting a fresh certificate before expiry; the verb is "renew".

items.question: Trong câu "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", từ "outage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In transit: TLS everywhere — 1.2 minimum, 1.3 preferred — including internal hops; HSTS on public sites; automated certificate renewal (expired certificates are a classic self-inflicted outage).", what does "outage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự gián đoạn dịch vụ. "A self-inflicted outage" = sự cố ngừng dịch vụ do chính mình gây ra, như để chứng chỉ hết hạn.
items.explanationEn: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (noun): a period of downtime. "A self-inflicted outage" is downtime you cause yourself, such as letting a certificate expire.

items.question: Trong câu "Encryption at rest protects against stolen disks and backups — not against an attacker using the application's own credentials.", từ "at rest" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Encryption at rest protects against stolen disks and backups — not against an attacker using the application's own credentials.", what does "at rest" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at rest /æt rest/ (cụm từ): khi đang lưu trữ. "Data at rest" = dữ liệu nằm trên đĩa; đối lập với "data in transit" = dữ liệu đang truyền.
items.explanationEn: at rest /æt rest/ (phrase): while stored, not moving. "Data at rest" sits on storage; the opposite is "data in transit", which is moving over a network.

items.question: Trong câu "KMS calls are networked and size-limited (AWS KMS encrypts at most 4 KB directly), so bulk data uses envelope encryption", từ "bulk" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "KMS calls are networked and size-limited (AWS KMS encrypts at most 4 KB directly), so bulk data uses envelope encryption", what does "bulk" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bulk /bʌlk/ (tính từ): khối lượng lớn. "Bulk data / bulk import" = dữ liệu số lượng lớn; "in bulk" = mua/xử lý số lượng lớn.
items.explanationEn: bulk /bʌlk/ (adjective): large in amount. "Bulk data" or "bulk import" means large volumes; "in bulk" means in large quantities.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: bulk data never travels to the KMS, each object can have its own data key, every master-key use is an audited policy decision, and rotating the master key does not require re-encrypting all data.", từ "audit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: bulk data never travels to the KMS, each object can have its own data key, every master-key use is an audited policy decision, and rotating the master key does not require re-encrypting all data.", what does "audit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (động từ): kiểm tra và ghi nhận. "An audited decision" = quyết định được ghi lại để kiểm tra sau; danh từ "audit" = cuộc kiểm toán.
items.explanationEn: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (verb): to inspect and record. "An audited decision" is recorded so it can be checked later; the noun "audit" is an official inspection.

items.question: Trong câu "Deleting a key makes data unrecoverable (crypto-shredding).", từ "unrecoverable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deleting a key makes data unrecoverable (crypto-shredding).", what does "unrecoverable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unrecoverable /ˌʌnrɪˈkʌvərəbl/ (tính từ): không thể khôi phục. Cấu tạo: un- (không) + recover (khôi phục) + -able (có thể).
items.explanationEn: unrecoverable /ˌʌnrɪˈkʌvərəbl/ (adjective): impossible to get back. Built from un- (not) + recover (get back) + -able (can be).

items.question: Trong câu "Normal TLS authenticates only the server.", từ "authenticate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Normal TLS authenticates only the server.", what does "authenticate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: authenticate /ɔːˈθentɪkeɪt/ (động từ): xác thực danh tính. Phân biệt "authenticate" (xác minh bạn là ai) với "authorise" (bạn được làm gì).
items.explanationEn: authenticate /ɔːˈθentɪkeɪt/ (verb): to verify identity. Distinguish "authenticate" (prove who you are) from "authorise" (decide what you may do).

items.question: Trong câu "Mutual TLS (mTLS) makes the client present a certificate too.", từ "mutual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mutual TLS (mTLS) makes the client present a certificate too.", what does "mutual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mutual /ˈmjuːtʃuəl/ (tính từ): lẫn nhau, hai chiều. "Mutual trust / mutual authentication" = tin tưởng hay xác thực từ cả hai phía.
items.explanationEn: mutual /ˈmjuːtʃuəl/ (adjective): shared by both sides. "Mutual trust" or "mutual authentication" works in both directions.

items.question: Trong câu "Mutual TLS (mTLS) makes the client present a certificate too.", từ "present" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mutual TLS (mTLS) makes the client present a certificate too.", what does "present" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: present /prɪˈzent/ (động từ): xuất trình, đưa ra. Động từ "present" nhấn âm tiết 2 /prɪˈzent/; "present a certificate / ID" = xuất trình chứng chỉ, giấy tờ.
items.explanationEn: present /prɪˈzent/ (verb): to show for checking. The verb "present" is stressed on the second syllable; "present a certificate or ID" means show it for checking.

items.question: Trong câu "Issuing and rotating certificates for hundreds of services by hand is impractical", từ "issue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Issuing and rotating certificates for hundreds of services by hand is impractical", what does "issue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: issue /ˈɪʃuː/ (động từ): cấp phát, phát hành. "Issue a certificate / a token" = cấp chứng chỉ hoặc token; danh từ "issue" lại là vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: issue /ˈɪʃuː/ (verb): to officially give out. "Issue a certificate" means to give one out officially; the noun "issue" means a problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Issuing and rotating certificates for hundreds of services by hand is impractical", từ "impractical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Issuing and rotating certificates for hundreds of services by hand is impractical", what does "impractical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: impractical /ɪmˈpræktɪkl/ (tính từ): không khả thi thực tế. "Impractical" = làm được về lý thuyết nhưng quá tốn công; khác "impossible" (không thể).
items.explanationEn: impractical /ɪmˈpræktɪkl/ (adjective): not sensible to do. "Impractical" means possible in theory but too much effort; it differs from "impossible".

items.question: Trong câu "whose proxies do mTLS and rotation transparently", từ "transparently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "whose proxies do mTLS and rotation transparently", what does "transparently" (adverb) mean?
options: trong suốt, không cần can thiệp
items.explanation: transparently /trænsˈpærəntli/ (trạng từ): trong suốt, không cần can thiệp. Trong kỹ thuật, "transparently" = tự động, ứng dụng không cần biết; nghĩa "minh bạch" dùng cho tổ chức.
items.explanationEn: transparently /trænsˈpærəntli/ (adverb): without users noticing. In computing, "transparently" means the app does not notice; "openly and honestly" is used for organisations.

items.question: Trong câu "The OWASP Top 10 (2021 edition) lists the most critical web risk categories.", từ "critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OWASP Top 10 (2021 edition) lists the most critical web risk categories.", what does "critical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (tính từ): nghiêm trọng, then chốt. "Critical vulnerability" = lỗ hổng rất nghiêm trọng; "critical of" lại là chỉ trích.
items.explanationEn: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (adjective): extremely serious. "A critical vulnerability" is very serious; "critical of something" means finding fault with it.

items.question: Trong câu "An architect looks for design decisions that remove a whole class.", từ "class" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An architect looks for design decisions that remove a whole class.", what does "class" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: class /klɑːs/ (danh từ): nhóm cùng loại. "A whole class of bugs" = cả một loại lỗi; kiến trúc tốt loại bỏ cả nhóm chứ không vá từng lỗi.
items.explanationEn: class /klɑːs/ (noun): a group of similar things. "A whole class of bugs" is an entire kind of bug; good design removes the kind, not single cases.

items.question: Trong câu "The 2025 edition keeps Broken Access Control first and gives software supply-chain failures their own category.", từ "edition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The 2025 edition keeps Broken Access Control first and gives software supply-chain failures their own category.", what does "edition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edition /ɪˈdɪʃn/ (danh từ): ấn bản, lần xuất bản. "The 2025 edition" = ấn bản năm 2025; phân biệt với "addition" (sự thêm vào).
items.explanationEn: edition /ɪˈdɪʃn/ (noun): one published version. "The 2025 edition" is the version published in 2025; do not confuse it with "addition".

items.question: Trong câu "a service that fetches user-supplied URLs can be tricked into calling internal endpoints such as the cloud metadata service at 169.254.169.254.", từ "trick" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a service that fetches user-supplied URLs can be tricked into calling internal endpoints such as the cloud metadata service at 169.254.169.254.", what does "trick" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (động từ): lừa, đánh lừa. Cấu trúc "trick somebody into doing something" = lừa ai làm việc gì.
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (verb): to deceive. The pattern is "trick somebody into doing something", meaning to fool them into it.

items.question: Trong câu "a service that fetches user-supplied URLs can be tricked into calling internal endpoints such as the cloud metadata service at 169.254.169.254.", từ "fetch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a service that fetches user-supplied URLs can be tricked into calling internal endpoints such as the cloud metadata service at 169.254.169.254.", what does "fetch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fetch /fetʃ/ (động từ): lấy về, tải về. "Fetch data from an API" = lấy dữ liệu từ API; nghĩa gốc là đi lấy về (như chó nhặt bóng).
items.explanationEn: fetch /fetʃ/ (verb): to go and get. "Fetch data from an API" means retrieving it; the basic sense is going to get something and bringing it back.

items.question: Trong câu "Fix it in the network too — egress filtering, an isolated fetcher service, IMDSv2 on AWS.", từ "egress" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix it in the network too — egress filtering, an isolated fetcher service, IMDSv2 on AWS.", what does "egress" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: egress /ˈiːɡres/ (danh từ): lưu lượng đi ra. "Egress" = đi ra; đối lập là "ingress" = đi vào. "Egress filtering" = lọc kết nối đi ra ngoài.
items.explanationEn: egress /ˈiːɡres/ (noun): outbound traffic. "Egress" means going out; the opposite is "ingress". "Egress filtering" limits outbound connections.

items.question: Trong câu "Fix it in the network too — egress filtering, an isolated fetcher service, IMDSv2 on AWS.", từ "isolated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix it in the network too — egress filtering, an isolated fetcher service, IMDSv2 on AWS.", what does "isolated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: isolated /ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd/ (tính từ): bị cô lập, tách riêng. "An isolated service / subnet" = dịch vụ hoặc mạng con tách biệt, không nối thẳng tới phần còn lại.
items.explanationEn: isolated /ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd/ (adjective): kept apart from others. "An isolated service" or "isolated subnet" is cut off from direct access to the rest of the system.

items.question: Trong câu "Segmentation limits lateral movement", từ "segmentation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Segmentation limits lateral movement", what does "segmentation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: segmentation /ˌseɡmenˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự chia thành vùng. "Network segmentation" = chia mạng thành các vùng nhỏ để giới hạn phạm vi tấn công.
items.explanationEn: segmentation /ˌseɡmenˈteɪʃn/ (noun): division into sections. "Network segmentation" splits a network into zones to limit how far an attack spreads.

items.question: Trong câu "Accounts — prod, staging and security tooling in separate cloud accounts.", từ "tooling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accounts — prod, staging and security tooling in separate cloud accounts.", what does "tooling" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tooling /ˈtuːlɪŋ/ (danh từ): bộ công cụ. "Tooling" là danh từ không đếm được, chỉ chung các công cụ phần mềm hỗ trợ công việc.
items.explanationEn: tooling /ˈtuːlɪŋ/ (noun): a set of tools. "Tooling" is uncountable and refers to the software tools that support a job as a whole.

items.question: Trong câu "Security groups that reference other groups", từ "reference" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security groups that reference other groups", what does "reference" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (động từ): tham chiếu tới. "Reference another resource" = trỏ tới tài nguyên khác thay vì ghi cứng giá trị như địa chỉ IP.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (verb): to point to. "Reference another resource" means pointing at it instead of hard-coding a value like an IP address.

items.question: Trong câu "A WAF inspects HTTP at layer 7 — managed rules for common attacks, bot control, rate-based rules — at the CDN, load balancer or gateway.", từ "inspect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WAF inspects HTTP at layer 7 — managed rules for common attacks, bot control, rate-based rules — at the CDN, load balancer or gateway.", what does "inspect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (động từ): kiểm tra kỹ. "Inspect traffic / packets" = soi xét nội dung lưu lượng; danh từ là "inspection".
items.explanationEn: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (verb): to examine closely. "Inspect traffic" means looking closely at its content; the noun is "inspection".

items.question: Trong câu "It is a layer, not a fix: great for virtual patching a fresh CVE, bypassable by a determined attacker.", từ "bypassable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a layer, not a fix: great for virtual patching a fresh CVE, bypassable by a determined attacker.", what does "bypassable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bypassable /ˈbaɪpɑːsəbl/ (tính từ): có thể bị lách qua. "Bypass" = đi vòng, lách qua; "bypass a control" = vượt qua lớp kiểm soát mà không bị chặn.
items.explanationEn: bypassable /ˈbaɪpɑːsəbl/ (adjective): able to be got around. "Bypass" means to go around; "bypass a control" is getting past it without being stopped.

items.question: Trong câu "It is a layer, not a fix: great for virtual patching a fresh CVE, bypassable by a determined attacker.", từ "determined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a layer, not a fix: great for virtual patching a fresh CVE, bypassable by a determined attacker.", what does "determined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: determined /dɪˈtɜːmɪnd/ (tính từ): quyết tâm, kiên trì. "A determined attacker" = kẻ tấn công quyết tâm; "determined by" lại nghĩa là được xác định bởi.
items.explanationEn: determined /dɪˈtɜːmɪnd/ (adjective): firmly set on a goal. "A determined attacker" will not give up; "determined by" means decided by something.

items.question: Trong câu "Roll out new rules in count mode first, then block.", từ "roll out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Roll out new rules in count mode first, then block.", what does "roll out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: roll out /rəʊl aʊt/ (cụm từ): triển khai dần. "Roll out a feature / an update" = đưa tính năng ra dần; danh từ là "rollout", trái nghĩa "roll back".
items.explanationEn: roll out /rəʊl aʊt/ (phrase): to introduce gradually. "Roll out a feature" means releasing it step by step; the noun is "rollout" and the opposite is "roll back".

items.question: Trong câu "Breaches increasingly come through what you build with: a compromised dependency, a poisoned build, a tampered image.", từ "increasingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breaches increasingly come through what you build with: a compromised dependency, a poisoned build, a tampered image.", what does "increasingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: increasingly /ɪnˈkriːsɪŋli/ (trạng từ): ngày càng nhiều. "Increasingly + adj/verb" = ngày càng; ví dụ "increasingly common".
items.explanationEn: increasingly /ɪnˈkriːsɪŋli/ (adverb): more and more. "Increasingly" shows a growing trend, as in "increasingly common".

items.question: Trong câu "Breaches increasingly come through what you build with: a compromised dependency, a poisoned build, a tampered image.", từ "tamper" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breaches increasingly come through what you build with: a compromised dependency, a poisoned build, a tampered image.", what does "tamper" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: tamper /ˈtæmpə(r)/ (động từ): sửa đổi trái phép. Thường dùng "tamper with something" = can thiệp, sửa lén; "tampering" là chữ T trong STRIDE.
items.explanationEn: tamper /ˈtæmpə(r)/ (verb): to alter without permission. Usually "tamper with something", meaning to interfere secretly; "tampering" is the T in STRIDE.

items.question: Trong câu "Admission control (Pod Security Admission restricted, Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper) rejects privileged, root or unsigned pods.", từ "privileged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Admission control (Pod Security Admission restricted, Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper) rejects privileged, root or unsigned pods.", what does "privileged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: privileged /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒd/ (tính từ): có quyền đặc biệt cao. "A privileged container" = container có quyền gần như root trên máy chủ; nghĩa xã hội là được ưu đãi.
items.explanationEn: privileged /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒd/ (adjective): having special system rights. "A privileged container" has near-root rights on the host; the social sense means advantaged.

items.question: Trong câu "CI identity via OIDC federation and short-lived tokens — the pipeline has production power.", từ "federation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI identity via OIDC federation and short-lived tokens — the pipeline has production power.", what does "federation" (noun) mean?
options: liên kết tin cậy danh tính
items.explanation: federation /ˌfedəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): liên kết tin cậy danh tính. "Identity federation" = hệ thống này tin danh tính do hệ thống khác cấp; nghĩa chính trị là liên bang.
items.explanationEn: federation /ˌfedəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): trust linking between systems. "Identity federation" lets one system trust identities issued by another; politically it means a union of states.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw a data flow diagram, mark trust boundaries, walk each element through STRIDE, and record mitigations as tickets or ADRs.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw a data flow diagram, mark trust boundaries, walk each element through STRIDE, and record mitigations as tickets or ADRs.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Trust boundary" = ranh giới nơi dữ liệu đi từ vùng tin cậy thấp sang vùng tin cậy cao.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a dividing line. "Trust boundary" is where data crosses from a less trusted zone into a more trusted one.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw a data flow diagram, mark trust boundaries, walk each element through STRIDE, and record mitigations as tickets or ADRs.", từ "mitigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw a data flow diagram, mark trust boundaries, walk each element through STRIDE, and record mitigations as tickets or ADRs.", what does "mitigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mitigation /ˌmɪtɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (danh từ): biện pháp giảm thiểu. Động từ "mitigate a risk" = giảm nhẹ rủi ro; không loại bỏ hoàn toàn mà làm nó bớt nghiêm trọng.
items.explanationEn: mitigation /ˌmɪtɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (noun): a way to reduce harm. The verb is "mitigate a risk": to make it less severe rather than remove it completely.

items.question: Trong câu "Threats cluster at trust boundaries, so review those flows first.", từ "cluster" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Threats cluster at trust boundaries, so review those flows first.", what does "cluster" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cluster /ˈklʌstə(r)/ (động từ): tụ lại, tập trung. Động từ "cluster" = tụ thành cụm; danh từ "cluster" trong IT thường là cụm máy chủ.
items.explanationEn: cluster /ˈklʌstə(r)/ (verb): to gather closely together. The verb "cluster" means to form a group; the noun in IT often means a group of servers.

items.question: Trong câu "In Vietnam, personal data is governed by Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and the newer Personal Data Protection Law.", từ "govern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Vietnam, personal data is governed by Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and the newer Personal Data Protection Law.", what does "govern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (động từ): điều chỉnh (bằng luật). "Be governed by a law / policy" = chịu sự điều chỉnh của luật hoặc chính sách; danh từ "governance".
items.explanationEn: govern /ˈɡʌvn/ (verb): to regulate by law. "Be governed by a law" means the law sets the rules for it; the related noun is "governance".

items.question: Trong câu "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", từ "retention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", what does "retention" (noun) mean?
options: sự lưu giữ theo thời gian
items.explanation: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (danh từ): sự lưu giữ theo thời gian. "Retention policy / period" = chính sách hoặc thời hạn giữ dữ liệu trước khi xoá.
items.explanationEn: retention /rɪˈtenʃn/ (noun): keeping data over time. "Retention policy" or "retention period" sets how long data is kept before deletion.

items.question: Trong câu "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (tính từ): không thể thay đổi. "Immutable logs / infrastructure" = không sửa được sau khi tạo; trái nghĩa là "mutable".
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. "Immutable logs" or "immutable infrastructure" cannot be modified once created; the opposite is "mutable".

items.question: Trong câu "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (tính từ): có chủ đích, cân nhắc. Tính từ "deliberate" /dɪˈlɪbərət/ = có chủ ý; trạng từ "deliberately" = cố ý.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (adjective): done on purpose. The adjective "deliberate" means intentional; the adverb "deliberately" means on purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", từ "residency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Patterns that make audits cheap: scope reduction (tokenise cards via the payment provider so you never store a PAN), data classification driving encryption and retention, immutable audit logs in a separate account, policy as code so evidence is Git history, and deliberate data residency.", what does "residency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the form data is kept in
items.explanation: residency /ˈrezɪdənsi/ (danh từ): nơi đặt dữ liệu. "Data residency" = quốc gia/khu vực nơi dữ liệu được lưu; luật có thể yêu cầu dữ liệu nằm trong nước.
items.explanationEn: residency /ˈrezɪdənsi/ (noun): the place data is kept. "Data residency" is the country or region where data is stored; laws may require it to stay local.

items.question: Trong câu "Compliance is a floor: certified does not mean secure.", từ "floor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compliance is a floor: certified does not mean secure.", what does "floor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the bottom surface of a room
items.explanation: floor /flɔː(r)/ (danh từ): mức tối thiểu. Nghĩa bóng "a floor" = mức sàn, tối thiểu; đối lập "a ceiling" = mức trần, tối đa.
items.explanationEn: floor /flɔː(r)/ (noun): a minimum level. Figuratively "a floor" is a lower limit; the opposite is "a ceiling", an upper limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Compliance is a floor: certified does not mean secure.", từ "certified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compliance is a floor: certified does not mean secure.", what does "certified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: certified /ˈsɜːtɪfaɪd/ (tính từ): được chứng nhận. "Certified" = đã đạt chứng nhận (ví dụ ISO 27001); danh từ "certification".
items.explanationEn: certified /ˈsɜːtɪfaɪd/ (adjective): officially approved. "Certified" means formally approved, for example against ISO 27001; the noun is "certification".

items.question: Trong câu "Security is a quality attribute: assume breach, minimise blast radius, name the trade-offs.", từ "minimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security is a quality attribute: assume breach, minimise blast radius, name the trade-offs.", what does "minimise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: minimise /ˈmɪnɪmaɪz/ (động từ): giảm tối đa. "Minimise" (Anh-Anh) = "minimize" (Anh-Mỹ); trái nghĩa là "maximise".
items.explanationEn: minimise /ˈmɪnɪmaɪz/ (verb): to reduce to the least. "Minimise" is British spelling of "minimize"; the opposite is "maximise".

items.question: Trong câu "Security is a quality attribute: assume breach, minimise blast radius, name the trade-offs.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security is a quality attribute: assume breach, minimise blast radius, name the trade-offs.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance of gains and losses
an exchange of goods for money
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "A trade-off between X and Y" = phải hy sinh cái này để được cái kia; rất hay gặp khi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance of gains and losses. "A trade-off between X and Y" means giving up some of one to gain the other; common in interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "Identity, least privilege, managed secrets and short-lived credentials close the common breach paths.", từ "credential" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identity, least privilege, managed secrets and short-lived credentials close the common breach paths.", what does "credential" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credential /krəˈdenʃl/ (danh từ): thông tin xác thực. Thường ở số nhiều "credentials" (mật khẩu, token, khoá); nghĩa khác là bằng cấp của một người.
items.explanationEn: credential /krəˈdenʃl/ (noun): proof of identity. Usually plural "credentials" (passwords, tokens, keys); another sense is a person's qualifications.

items.question: Trong câu "Architects decide how far one failure spreads; CIA and shared responsibility frame decisions.", từ "frame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architects decide how far one failure spreads; CIA and shared responsibility frame decisions.", what does "frame" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a border around a picture
to shape how something is seen
items.explanation: frame /freɪm/ (động từ): định hướng cách nhìn. "Frame a decision / a problem" = đặt vấn đề trong một khuôn khổ tư duy; danh từ "framework".
items.explanationEn: frame /freɪm/ (verb): to shape how something is seen. "Frame a decision" means setting the way it is thought about; compare the noun "framework".

items.question: Trong câu "STRIDE and compliance turn security into reviewable architecture decisions.", từ "reviewable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "STRIDE and compliance turn security into reviewable architecture decisions.", what does "reviewable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reviewable /rɪˈvjuːəbl/ (tính từ): có thể rà soát. Hậu tố "-able" = có thể; quyết định được ghi lại thì người khác có thể xem xét và góp ý.
items.explanationEn: reviewable /rɪˈvjuːəbl/ (adjective): able to be examined. The suffix "-able" means can be; recorded decisions can be examined and challenged by others.
